extraction.notes: Three months ended September 30, 2022 column only. Subtotals verified: 121,389 + adjustments = 259,961 FFO; 259,961 + core adjustments = 259,505 Core FFO; 259,505 - 38,669 = 220,836 Core AFFO. Shares 118,643K / 118,643 thousand units reproduce FFO $2.19, Core FFO $2.19, Core AFFO $1.86. The 'Legal costs and settlements, net' line is a dash (zero) for Q3 2022. The 'Gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate assets' is categorized as nareit_other (it sits in the core adjustments but is not depreciable real estate). COVID-19 costs categorized as 'other'. Mark-to-market debt adjustment (interest expense) categorized as debt_cost_amortization. AFFO subtracts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null; redevelopment, revenue-enhancing, commercial and other capex lines are below Core AFFO (FAD) and were not included.
